end.summary:
Practised defining food miles and identifying where foods come from.
Compared nearby spinach with apples from Shimla and food from 10 km away.
Connected greater food miles with more truck travel, fuel use, pollution, and reduced freshness.
Rohan initially said “fuel miles” but corrected this to “food miles”; teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the idea of food miles through examples of nearby spinach, apples from Shimla, and food travelling 10 km. Rohan used the method of linking distance with truck travel, fuel use, pollution, and freshness, and corrected the “fuel miles” mix-up to “food miles” later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, ask them to choose two foods and compare which travelled farther and what that might mean for fuel use and freshness.
